title: Critical Chemical Shortage With Conflicting Evidence
request_text: The City has fewer than four days of disinfectant chemical remaining for its water treatment operations. The regular supplier advised that its next shipment will be delayed by two weeks because of a regional transportation disruption. Water Operations requests emergency authority to purchase the chemical from Western Treatment Supply, which can deliver within 48 hours.

available_documents.title: Regular Supplier Delay Notice
available_documents.summary: States that the next shipment will be delayed two weeks because of a regional transportation disruption.

available_documents.title: Chemical Inventory Report
available_documents.summary: Shows fewer than four days of disinfectant supply remaining.

available_documents.title: Operations Memorandum
available_documents.summary: Explains that water treatment cannot continue safely without the chemical.

available_documents.title: Low-Inventory Warning Email
available_documents.summary: Shows staff were warned three weeks earlier that inventory was below the normal reorder level.

available_documents.title: Late Requisition Record
available_documents.summary: Shows the replenishment requisition was submitted later than required by the normal process.

available_documents.title: Alternative Supplier Email
available_documents.summary: An alternate supplier can deliver in five days at a lower price.
